question: Why did Abram refuse to take any reward from the king of Sodom?
options: He did not need any more wealth
So no one could say the king of Sodom had made Abram rich
He wanted the goods given to Lot instead
The king of Sodom had offended him
explanation: Abram refused so that the king of Sodom could never claim he had made Abram rich; Abram trusted God alone as his provider.
